tasks.short: Support legal hearings and provide testimony

steps.what: Identify relevant legal issues and authorised case material for hearings
Locate and arrange hearing documents without changing their factual content
Address legal issues, assist hearings and provide testimony about custody arrangements

tasks.design: Use native document filters and source links in the {OTHER} case-record system and {DOCS} to retrieve selected hearing references. The social worker chooses what is relevant and permitted, reads the originals and gives their own evidence; no generated testimony or custody recommendation is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding already selected source documents may require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case and document filters can shorten source retrieval without generating legal conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Relevance, disclosure limits and distinguishing observed facts from interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The worker answers questions candidly and takes responsibility for professional evidence.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less document navigation; professional and legal responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Check that a permitted hearing document is the current filed version

evidence.claim: Native document filtering can reduce navigation for selected case sources. This is an E1 design assumption, not evidence that social-work note-drafting tools can give testimony.

assumptions: Boundary is focal worker hearing preparation and participation, not legal advice by a lawyer, court decisions or a new case-note drafting process.
Worker s1 produces the authorised list with case ID, document IDs, dates, relevant event categories and disclosure scope. Selection and capture retain all 25 hours.

Original document authors supply existing signed records through unchanged casework. Worker s2 enters or selects the IDs, checks versions and reads source context within retained 9 hours. Missing metadata leads to manual search.
Test native document search and saved views before custom code. No new structured allegation flag, automated risk judgement or automatic disclosure is assumed.
research_questions: Does saved-source retrieval reduce navigation while preserving complete context and permitted disclosure?

already_counted.description: Verify source identity, version and context and resolve retrieval gaps

incremental.description: Check saved views and permission links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=25+9+60=94. Gross 6 less 1 upkeep gives net 5. Low assumes easy existing retrieval; high requires the 15-hour navigation slice. Source selection, testimony and hearing assistance retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel parents and interview the child and family

steps.what: Counsel parents, interview the child and family and determine whether further action is required

tasks.design: Keep counselling, interviewing and the further-action judgement with the social worker. Existing case context in the {OTHER} case-record system can inform the conversation without recording or analysing it through a new tool.
tasks.previous_blocker: Understanding child-rearing concerns requires trust and contextual assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: No new technical capability changes this direct-work boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing the child independently and recognising conflicting or incomplete accounts.
tasks.human_edge: The worker builds trust, asks careful questions and responds to the actual family situation.
tasks.altitude: Direct work and professional responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss the boundary for a family-support referral

evidence.claim: The digest describes report-drafting capability; it does not establish reduced counselling or interview time. This design retains direct work.

assumptions: Boundary is counselling, interview and professional judgement, not separately assigned case-record writing or scheduling.
Family and child produce their accounts directly; the worker observes interaction. No structured further-action flag is assumed or produced for automation.
Native case access remains as today. No new recording, model, software or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
Overlapping family counselling descriptions must be assigned once in a roll-up, not added together.
unknowns: Family circumstances and local service responsibilities
research_questions: What helps the worker hear the child's perspective without increasing pressure on the child?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and incremental=0. Neither routine family support nor complex further-action judgements lose contact time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult families and school staff about problems and solutions

steps.what: Consult parents, teachers and school personnel to determine problem causes and implement solutions

tasks.design: Retain consultation and joint implementation with the social worker and school participants. Existing permitted records in the {OTHER} case-record system support their discussion without turning truancy or behaviour observations into automatic causal claims.
tasks.previous_blocker: Causes are disputed or incomplete and solutions require cooperation.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is proposed for the substantive consultation.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling accounts and agreeing support that the family and school can actually carry out.
tasks.human_edge: The worker hears different perspectives and negotiates realistic actions.
tasks.altitude: Consultation time and case responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Agree who follows up a school support action
reach.learn: School support roles and information-sharing limits

evidence.claim: Cooperative problem assessment and implementation remain human work; no labour reduction follows from note-drafting capability alone.

assumptions: Boundary is focal worker substantive consultation and direct coordination of solutions, not a new minutes or diary task. Other participants' time remains unchanged and outside the focal denominator.
Parents, child and school staff produce their own accounts during consultation; worker considers existing permitted records. No structured cause or behavioural-risk field is assumed.
Test existing native record access where helpful, but introduce no new software or capture requirement. Zero incremental upkeep follows from the unchanged design.
If this consultation also forms part of family counselling, the roll-up must assign the contact hours once.
research_questions: Do participants understand who will carry out each agreed action?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and incremental=0. Consultation and implementation time remain intact in straightforward and contested cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel people about social and wellbeing concerns

steps.what: Counsel individuals, groups, families or communities about mental health, poverty and other social concerns

tasks.design: Keep counselling with the qualified social worker within their professional scope. Existing approved support information in the {DOCS} may be consulted, but this design does not replace conversation or automate a care recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: People need responsive support grounded in their own circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is proposed for this counselling boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising urgent concerns while respecting autonomy and professional limits.
tasks.human_edge: The worker listens, builds trust and responds with contextual judgement.
tasks.altitude: Counselling responsibilities and contact time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify a client's access to an existing support service
reach.learn: Local service boundaries and respectful referral

evidence.claim: Counselling time is retained; documentation savings reported for a social-work pilot do not establish a reduction in this direct-work task.

assumptions: Boundary is direct counselling rather than case-note preparation, referral paperwork or eligibility decisions.
Clients produce concerns in their own words during contact; no new recording or structured needs profile is assumed.
Existing native reference access is sufficient; no new automation, capture or upkeep is proposed, so incremental work is zero.
Family counselling and other overlapping contact descriptions need a single owner in the team roll-up.
research_questions: Which access barriers prevent clients from following their agreed next steps?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0. Direct individual, family and group counselling retain all focal contact time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep direct family and school work personal, with a small possible reduction in hearing-reference navigation.
reach: Clarify school support ownership with a school counsellor
Discuss referral boundaries with a family therapist
skills_to_grow: Check source context and disclosure limits
Coordinate support without duplicating contact work
role.ambitious_version: Prepare traceable hearing references while preserving time for families, children and professional consultation.

job.title: Child, Family, and School Social Workers
